verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party 'OpenTelemetry in Datadog' docs page. One customer reports sending OTel-instrumented Elixir telemetry to Datadog, which supports instrumenting with an open standard and having Datadog act as one interchangeable backend. However, that customer used OTel only because no native Datadog SDK exists for Elixir, which suggests Datadog's primary path is its own proprietary instrumentation. The evidence pack provides only the docs page title, so feature parity for OTel data is unverified. Missing for 10: documented detail on OTLP ingestion and supported signals, evidence of feature parity between OTel-sourced and native-SDK data, and evidence of actually switching backends without re-instrumenting.
